subject: Maintenance holdback policy and quiet window — NorthStar Private deployment
messages:
From: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@northstarfinancial.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@northstarfinancial.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NorthStar: maintenance constraints and version-hold request

Vivek —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We finished our internal compliance review and have one ask before we sign the Private deployment SOW: NorthStar needs a documented maintenance "holdback" policy for any non-critical version changes to our environment. Specifically: 

- No automatic major/minor model/runtime bumps for our VPC cluster without a scheduled maintenance window and exec sign-off.
- Emergency security fixes are OK, but we want a post-fix audit and the ability to roll back to the prior pinned version within a 2-hour SLA.
- We need a quiet window (no changes) for payroll cutover dates: first weekend of every month.

Can you send a short RFC that outlines the holdback policy, proposed quiet windows, how rollbacks are authorized, and what preflight checks RackCloud will run? We prefer a single page summary and a technical appendix.

Claire
Claire Dawson
VP, Infrastructure Security — NorthStar Financial
claire.dawson@northstarfinancial.com
Attachments: none
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@northstarfinancial.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@northstarfinancial.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 17 Jun 2028 12:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NorthStar: maintenance constraints and version-hold request

Claire —

Appreciate the clarity. I've attached a concise RFC and a canary runbook appendix we use for Private customers. High level proposal here (TL;DR):

1) Version holdback policy
   - Customer pin: By default customers can pin both model and runtime to a specific semantic version (e.g., model v1.8.2 / runtime 2.3.1). Redwood will not apply automatic minor/major bumps to pinned fields.
   - Security-only exceptions: CVE-critical patches (CVSS >=9.0) may be applied with 2-hour notification and automatic rollback capability.

2) Quiet windows
   - Proposed recurring quiet window: 00:00–08:00 PT on the first Saturday of each month (no non-emergency changes).
   - Ad-hoc blackout days: NorthStar can nominate up to 6 dates per year for calendar-level holdbacks (payroll cutovers etc.).

3) Rollback & authorization
   - Rollbacks follow a 3-person authorization (customer ops lead + Redwood oncall + RackCloud engineer).
   - Rollback target: previous pinned release; recovery SLA target 2 hours measured from rollback authorization.

4) Preflight & gating
   - Preflight: smoke tests, KV-cache integrity check, canary traffic soak (30 min), token-level latency/95th check.
   - Automated gating: any perf regression >15% or error rate >1% triggers automatic halt and rollback.

I've asked Karthik to draft the rollback matrix with exact commands and expected pod-state transitions. RackCloud: can you confirm you'll run the preflight checklist and be available for rollback?

Attachments: northstar_holdback_rfc.pdf (1 page summary + appendix), canary_runbook.md

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@northstarfinancial.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Jun 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Maintenance holdback policy and quiet window — rollback matrix draft

Vivek / Claire —

Drafting the technical rollback matrix below (high level). I'll attach the runbook snippets to the RFC folder.

Rollback matrix (high-level):
- Trigger: manual authorization OR automated gating (perf/error thresholds).
- Steps (expected timeline):
   1) Authorization confirmed (t=0) — customer ops + Redwood + RackCloud (3-way). Expected 5 min.
   2) Drain new model instances (t=5–10m) — stop accepting new sessions, finish active requests.
   3) Hot-swap to pinned artifacts (t=10–40m) — deploy pinned runtime/model, apply KV-cache compatibility shim if needed.
   4) Canary soak (t=40–70m) — 15–30 min canary, run smoke and token-sample regressions.
   5) Full ramp (t=70–120m) — phased traffic cutover. Target full restore <120m; operational target 2 hours.

Important notes:
- We recommend keeping a rolling snapshot of KV caches for 48 hours to reduce warmup when rolling back.
- For model weights >50GB, allow an extra 20–40 minutes for artifact transfer unless RackCloud can pre-stage pinned artifacts on the node.
- If rollback is due to a security hotfix we can fast-path to step 3 with a reduced canary (5–10 min) if the change is targeted to infra only (not model weights).

Preflight checklist (short): helm diff, cluster health=green, disk space >20% free, network egress baseline verified, canary route ready. I recommend RackCloud run the provided preflight spreadsheet the morning of any scheduled window.

On the quiet window timing — 00:00–08:00 PT on first Sat is fine for us; if NorthStar prefers a later start we can shift.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Vivek / Claire —

Thanks — RackCloud confirms we can support the proposed holdback policy and quiet window. Quick notes from Service Delivery: 

- Pre-staging: we can pre-stage pinned artifacts on the 3 primary rack groups if you provide the pinned artifact hashes 48 hours prior. This reduces transfer time for large models.
- Preflight checklist: completed the worksheet you attached in our staging cluster and will run it again as part of preflight at T-2h for scheduled windows. See attached checklist.
- On rollback SLA: our engineers can meet the 2-hour recovery target for most cases. Exceptions: rollback that requires rehydrating >200GB of model shards may extend to 3 hours unless pre-staged.

We will also provide a short runbook snippet for customers to execute a fast-path security rollback (replacing step 3 canary with abbreviated sanity checks).

Attachments: rackcloud_preflight_checklist.xlsx (staging results template)

Regards,
